passages.note: Hawkins voted Yea on House final passage of 2SB 100; 6 Nays of a 75-member body is under 10%, so the vote cannot carry a chair alone.
passages.actor_quote: Hall, K. Hawkins, J. Hollins, S.

passages.provision_quote: a school or LEA may not: 45 (a) prohibit a parent of a child from accessing the child's education record; or 46 (b) without written parental consent make changes to a student's education record 47 regarding a student's gender identity that does not conform with the student's sex.
passages.note: Operative text guarantees parental access to records and requires consent for record changes, not proactive notification or consent for staff use of names/pronouns, so it shows the parental-access side without matching one rung's every clause.

rows.reasoning: Hawkins voted Yea on S.B. 100 (2023), whose operative section bars schools from blocking a parent's access to the education record and from changing that record's gender identity without written parental consent. That places him on the parental-access side, but the bill neither requires schools to notify parents nor requires permission before staff use a different name or pronouns, and its record-access clause alone does not exclude those rungs; the vote is also near-unanimous.
